headings: Federal Deposit Insurance. The Bank's deposits are insured to applicable limits by the FDIC. The general maximum deposit insurance amount is $250,000.
paragraphs: Norwood Financial Corp (the "Company"), a Pennsylvania corporation, was incorporated in 1995 to become the holding company for Wayne Bank (the "Bank"). The Company is a registered bank holding company subject to regulation and supervision by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System ("Federal Reserve"). As of December 31, 2025, the Company had total consolidated assets of $2.425 billion, consolidated deposits of $2.183 billion, and consolidated stockholders' equity of $242.2 million. The Company's ratio of average equity to average assets was 9.59%, 8.26%, and 8.14% for fiscal years 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

Wayne Bank is a Pennsylvania chartered bank and trust company headquartered in Honesdale, Pennsylvania. The Bank was originally chartered on February 17, 1870, as Wayne County Savings Bank and changed its name to Wayne County Bank and Trust in December 1943. In September 1993, the Bank adopted the name Wayne Bank. The Bank's deposits are insured to applicable limits by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation ("FDIC") and the Bank is a member of the Federal Home Loan Bank ("FHLB") of Pittsburgh. The Bank is regulated and examined by the Pennsylvania Department of Banking and Securities ("Department") and the FDIC. The Bank is an independent community bank with fifteen offices in Northeastern Pennsylvania and fourteen offices in Delaware, Sullivan, Ontario, Otsego and Yates Counties, New York.

The Bank offers a wide variety of personal and business credit services and trust and investment products and real estate settlement services to the consumers, businesses, nonprofit organizations, and municipalities in each of the communities that the Bank serves. The Bank primarily serves the northeastern Pennsylvania counties of Wayne, Pike, Monroe, Lackawanna and Luzerne and, to a much lesser extent, Susquehanna County in addition to the New York counties of Delaware, Sullivan, Ontario, Otsego and Yates. In addition, the Bank operates automated teller machines at 29 branch facilities plus one machine at an off-site location.

The Company's main office is located at 717 Main Street, Honesdale, Pennsylvania and its main telephone number is (570) 253-1455. The Company maintains a website at wayne.bank. Information on our website should not be treated as part of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. The Company makes copies of its Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC") filings available free of charge as soon as reasonably practicable after they are filed through a link on its website to the SEC's website.

UpState New York Bancorp, Inc. On July 7, 2020, the Company completed the acquisition of UpState New York Bancorp, Inc. ("UpState"), and its wholly owned subsidiary, USNY Bank ("USNY Bank"). The acquisition was completed when UpState was merged with and into the Company, with the Company as the surviving corporation of the merger and USNY Bank was merged with and into Wayne Bank, with Wayne Bank as the surviving entity. At the time of completion of the acquisition, USNY Bank conducted its business from two Bank of the Finger Lakes offices in Geneva and Penn Yan, New York, and two Bank of Cooperstown offices in Cooperstown and Oneonta, New York.

In the merger, shareholders of UpState elected to receive for each share of UpState common stock they owned, either 0.9390 shares of the Company's common stock or $33.33 in cash, or a combination of both. All shareholder elections were subject to the allocation and proration procedures set forth in the Merger Agreement which were intended to ensure that 90% of the shares of UpState would be exchanged for the Company's common stock and 10% of the shares of UpState would be exchanged for cash. In addition, under the terms of the Merger Agreement, UpState shareholders received an additional $0.67 per share in cash for each share of UpState common stock held. In the aggregate, the merger consideration paid to UpState shareholders consisted of approximately $8,845,198 in cash and 1,865,738 shares of the Company's common stock.

Delaware Bancshares, Inc. On July 31, 2016, the Company completed the acquisition of Delaware Bancshares, Inc. ("Delaware") and its wholly owned subsidiary, The National Bank of Delaware County ("NBDC"). At the time of acquisition, Delaware had approximately $375.6 million in assets and 12 banking offices in Delaware and Sullivan Counties, New York. Pursuant to the terms of the Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated March 10, 2016, by and among the Company, Wayne Bank, Delaware and NBDC (the "Delaware Agreement"), Delaware was merged with and into the Company, with the Company as the surviving corporation of the merger (the "Merger") and NBDC was merged with and into Wayne Bank immediately thereafter. At the effective time of the Merger, each outstanding share of the common stock of Delaware was converted, at the election of the holder but subject to the limitations and allocation and proration provisions set forth in the Delaware Agreement, into either $16.68 in cash or 0.6221 of a share of the Company's common stock, par value $0.10 per share (the "Common Stock"). In the aggregate, the merger consideration paid to Delaware shareholders consisted of approximately $3,860,000 in cash and 431,605 shares of the Common Stock.

On May 31, 2011, the Company completed the acquisition of North Penn Bancorp, Inc. ("North Penn") and its wholly owned subsidiary, North Penn Bank. At the time of acquisition, North Penn had approximately $158.9 million in assets and four banking offices in Lackawanna and Monroe Counties, Pennsylvania. Pursuant to the terms of the Agreement and Plan of Merger by and among the Company, Wayne Bank, and North Penn, North Penn was merged with and into the Company, with the Company as the surviving corporation of the merger (the "Merger") and North Penn Bank was merged with and into Wayne Bank immediately thereafter. At the effective time of the Merger, each outstanding share of the common stock of North Penn was converted, at the election of the holder but subject to the limitations and allocation and proration provisions set forth in the Merger Agreement, into either $19.12 in cash or 0.6829 of a share of the Company's common stock, par value $0.10 per share (the "Common Stock"). In the aggregate, the merger consideration paid to North Penn shareholders consisted of approximately $10,648,000 in cash and 530,994 shares of the Common Stock.

The competition for deposit products comes from other insured financial institutions such as commercial banks, thrift institutions, credit unions, and multi-state regional banks in the Company's market area of Wayne, Pike, Monroe, Lackawanna and Luzerne Counties, Pennsylvania and Delaware, Sullivan, Ontario, Otsego and Yates Counties, New York as well as from on-line banks. Based on data compiled by the FDIC as of June 30, 2025 (the latest date for which such data is available), the Bank had the third largest share of FDIC-insured deposits in Wayne County with approximately 22.50%, the second largest share in Pike County with 17.76%, sixth largest share in Monroe County with 3.89%, the tenth largest share in Lackawanna County with 1.19% and the sixteenth largest share in Luzerne County with 0.42%. At June 30, 2025, the Bank had the largest share of FDIC-insured deposits in Delaware County, New York, with 31.39% and the fourth largest share in Sullivan County, New York, with 12.45%. The Bank's market share in Ontario, Otsego and Yates Counties were 5.87%, 14.87% and 18.52%, respectively. This data does not reflect deposits held by credit unions with which the Bank also competes. Deposit competition also includes a number of insurance products sold by local agents and investment products such as mutual funds and other securities sold by local and regional brokers. Loan competition varies depending upon market conditions and comes from other insured financial institutions such as commercial banks, thrift institutions, credit unions, multi-state regional banks, and mortgage bankers.
As of December 31, 2025, the Bank had 275 full-time and six part-time employees. None of the Bank's employees are represented by a collective bargaining group.

The Bank operates a Wealth Management/Trust Department which provides estate planning, investment management and financial planning to customers for which it is generally compensated based on a percentage of assets under management. As of December 31, 2025, the Bank had $213.9 million of assets under management compared to $205.1 million as of December 31, 2024. The increase reflects growth and improved market valuations during 2025, such as stock market performance which can affect the value of a customer's investment portfolio.

The Bank, a Pennsylvania chartered bank, is the only wholly owned subsidiary of the Company. Norwood Investment Corp. ("NIC"), a Pennsylvania corporation incorporated in 1996 and a Pennsylvania licensed insurance agency, is a wholly owned subsidiary of the Bank. NIC's business is brokerage activities including stocks, bonds, mutual funds, exchange traded funds and advisory services, as well as annuity and insurance products, primarily to customers of the Bank. The annuities, mutual funds and other investment products are not insured by the FDIC or any other government agency. They are not deposits, obligations of, or guaranteed by any bank. Until February 16, 2018, securities were offered through Invest Financial, a registered broker/dealer. Effective February 16, 2018, the broker/dealer relationship transitioned to LPL Financial LLC ("LPL") as a result of the sale of Invest to LPL in 2017. LPL is a registered broker/dealer and a member of FINRA and the SIPC. NIC generated gross revenues for the Company of $708,000 and $407,000 in 2025 and 2024, respectively, which is included in Other Income.

WCB Realty Corp., a Pennsylvania corporation, is a wholly owned real estate subsidiary of the Bank whose principal asset is the administrative offices of the Company, which also includes the Main Office of the Bank.

WTRO Properties Inc. ("WTRO"), a Pennsylvania corporation, is a wholly owned real estate subsidiary of the Bank established to hold title to certain real estate upon which the Bank has foreclosed. As of December 31, 2025 and 2024, the outstanding balance of foreclosed properties on which WTRO held title totaled $0 and $0, respectively.

paragraphs: This Management's Discussion and Analysis and related financial data are presented to assist in the understanding and evaluation of the financial condition and results of operations for the Company and the Bank, as of December 31, 2025 and 2024, and for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024. This section should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements and related footnotes.

During the year ended December 31, 2024, the Company's financial condition and results of operations were significantly impacted by two transactions. On December 23, 2024, the Company completed the underwritten public offering and sale of 1,150,000 shares of its common stock at $26.00 per share, resulting in net proceeds to the Company of approximately $28 million (the "Offering"). Immediately subsequent to the Offering, the Company utilized a portion of the net proceeds from the Offering to reposition a substantial portion of the Company's available-for-sale debt securities portfolio. The Company undertook the repositioning transactions with the objective of increasing the profitability of its investment portfolio, improving liquidity, strengthening its capital position and supporting future growth. Please see "Financial Condition—Securities" below for more information on the repositioning transactions.

Note 2 to the Company's consolidated financial statements lists significant accounting policies used in the development and presentation of its financial statements. This discussion and analysis, the significant accounting policies, and other financial statement disclosures identify and address key variables and other qualitative and quantitative factors that are necessary for an understanding and evaluation of the Company and its results of operations.

Material estimates that are particularly susceptible to significant change in the near term relate to the determination of the allowance for credit losses and the determination of goodwill impairment. Please refer to the discussion of the allowance for credit losses calculation under "Allowance for Credit Losses and Non-performing Assets" in the "Financial Condition" section.

In connection with the acquisition of North Penn in 2011, we recorded goodwill in the amount of $9.7 million, representing the excess of amounts paid over the fair value of the net assets of the institution acquired at the date of acquisition. In connection with the acquisition of Delaware in 2016, we recorded goodwill in the amount of $1.6 million, representing the excess of amounts paid over the fair value of the net assets of the institution acquired at the date of acquisition. In connection with the acquisition of UpState in July 2020, we recorded goodwill in the amount of $17.9 million, representing the excess of amounts paid over the fair value of the net assets of the institution acquired at the date of acquisition. Goodwill is tested annually and deemed impaired when the carrying value of goodwill exceeds its implied fair value.

paragraphs: Norwood Financial Corp (the "Company"), 一間位於賓夕法尼亞州的公司，於1995年成立，成為Wayne Bank (the "Bank") 的控股公司。本公司為一經註冊的銀行控股公司，受美國聯邦儲備系統 ("Federal Reserve") 的監管與監督。截至2025年12月31日，本公司合併總資產為2.425 十億美元，合併總存款為2.183 十億美元，合併股東權益為242.2 百萬美元。本公司平均權益與平均資產比率於2025會計年度為9.59%，2024會計年度為8.26%，2023會計年度為8.14%。

Wayne Bank為一間位於賓夕法尼亞州霍內斯代爾的賓夕法尼亞州註冊銀行與信託公司。該銀行最初於1870年2月17日註冊為Wayne County Savings Bank，並於1943年12月更名為Wayne County Bank and Trust。1993年9月，該銀行採用現名Wayne Bank。該銀行的存款由美國存款保險公司 ("FDIC") 依照適用的保險上限進行保險，且該銀行為匹茲堡地區聯邦住宅貸款銀行 ("FHLB") 的成員。該銀行受賓夕法尼亞州銀行與證券部門 ("Department") 與FDIC的監管與審查。該銀行為一間獨立的社區銀行，在賓夕法尼亞州東北部擁有十五間分行，在紐約州的Delaware、Sullivan、Ontario、Otsego與Yates縣擁有十四間分行。

該銀行為其服務的社區內個人與企業提供廣泛的信貸服務與信託與投資產品，以及不動產結算服務，服務對象包括消費者、企業、非營利組織與地方政府。該銀行主要服務賓夕法尼亞州東北部的Wayne、Pike、Monroe、Lackawanna與Luzerne縣，以及紐約州的Delaware、Sullivan、Ontario、Otsego與Yates縣，且服務程度較低的Susquehanna縣。此外，該銀行在29間分行設有自動提款機，並在一個非分行場地設有1臺提款機。
本公司的總部位於賓夕法尼亞州霍內斯代爾的717 Main Street，主要電話號碼為(570) 253-1455。本公司維護網站於wayne.bank。本網站的資訊不應視為本10-K年度報告的一部分。本公司會在提交後盡速提供其美國證券交易委員會 ("SEC") 的申報文件副本，透過網站連結至SEC網站。

UpState New York Bancorp, Inc. 本公司於2020年7月7日完成對UpState New York Bancorp, Inc. ("UpState") 及其全資子公司USNY Bank ("USNY Bank") 的收購。此收購於UpState與本公司合併，本公司為合併後的存續公司，且USNY Bank與Wayne Bank合併，Wayne Bank為合併後的存續機構。於收購完成時，USNY Bank的業務從紐約州Geneva與Penn Yan的Bank of the Finger Lakes分行，以及Cooperstown與Oneonta的Bank of Cooperstown分行進行。

於合併中，UpState股東可選擇以每持有1股UpState普通股，換取0.9390股本公司普通股，或33.33美元現金，或兩者組合。所有股東選擇均受合併協議中所規定的分配與比例程序限制，以確保90%的UpState股數換取本公司普通股，10%的UpState股數換取現金。此外，根據合併協議條款，UpState股東每持有1股UpState普通股，可額外獲得0.67美元現金。總計，支付給UpState股東的合併對價為約8,845,198美元現金及1,865,738股本公司普通股。

Delaware Bancshares, Inc. 本公司於2016年7月31日完成對Delaware Bancshares, Inc. ("Delaware") 及其全資子公司The National Bank of Delaware County ("NBDC") 的收購。於收購時，Delaware擁有約375.6 百萬美元資產及紐約州Delaware與Sullivan縣的12間銀行分行。根據2016年3月10日簽訂的合併協議 ("Delaware Agreement")，Delaware與本公司合併，本公司為合併後的存續公司 ("Merger")，且NBDC隨即與Wayne Bank合併。於合併生效時，Delaware每持有1股普通股，可選擇換取16.68美元現金或0.6221股本公司普通股 (每股面值0.10美元)。總計，支付給Delaware股東的合併對價為約3,860,000美元現金及431,605股本公司普通股。

本公司於2011年5月31日完成對North Penn Bancorp, Inc. ("North Penn") 及其全資子公司North Penn Bank 的收購。於收購時，North Penn擁有約158.9 百萬美元資產及賓夕法尼亞州Lackawanna與Monroe縣的4間銀行分行。根據合併協議，North Penn與本公司合併，本公司為合併後的存續公司 ("Merger")，且North Penn Bank隨即與Wayne Bank合併。於合併生效時，North Penn每持有1股普通股，可選擇換取19.12美元現金或0.6829股本公司普通股 (每股面值0.10美元)。總計，支付給North Penn股東的合併對價為約10,648,000美元現金及530,994股本公司普通股。

存款產品的競爭來自於其他有保險的金融機構，例如商業銀行、儲蓄機構、信用合作社以及在本公司市場區域 Wayne、Pike、Monroe、Lackawanna 和 Luzerne 縣，Pennsylvania 和 Delaware、Sullivan、Ontario、Otsego 和 Yates 縣，紐約州的多州區域銀行，以及網際網路銀行。根據 FDIC 編製的資料，截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日（最新資料日期），銀行在 Wayne 縣擁有 FDIC 保險存款的第三大市佔率，約為 22.50%，在 Pike 縣擁有第二大市佔率，為 17.76%，在 Monroe 縣擁有第六大市佔率，為 3.89%，在 Lackawanna 縣擁有第十大市佔率，為 1.19%，在 Luzerne 縣擁有第十六大市佔率，為 0.42%。截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日，銀行在 Delaware 縣，紐約州擁有 FDIC 保險存款的最大市佔率，為 31.39%，在 Sullivan 縣，紐約州擁有第四大市佔率，為 12.45%。銀行在 Ontario、Otsego 和 Yates 縣的市佔率分別為 5.87%、14.87% 和 18.52%。此資料未反映信用合作社的存款，而這些信用合作社與銀行也有競爭。存款競爭也包括當地經紀所銷售的多種保險產品，以及當地和區域經紀所銷售的共同基金和其他證券等投資產品。貸款競爭則視市場條件而定，來自於其他有保險的金融機構，例如商業銀行、儲蓄機構、信用合作社、多州區域銀行以及房貸經紀人。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，銀行有 275 名全職員工及 6 名兼職員工。銀行的員工均未加入集體談判團體。
銀行設有財富管理／信託部門，為客戶提供遺產規劃、投資管理及財務規劃服務，通常根據其管理資產的百分比收取費用。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，銀行管理的資產為 213.9 百萬美元，較 2024 年 12 月 31 日的 205.1 百萬美元有所增加。此增加反映 2025 年的成長及市場價值改善，例如股市表現，這會影響客戶投資組合的價值。

銀行為一家賓夕法尼亞州發行的銀行，為本公司唯一完全擁有之子公司。Norwood Investment Corp.（"NIC"），一家於 1996 年成立的賓夕法尼亞州公司，並為賓夕法尼亞州有保險代理牌照的機構，為銀行之完全擁有子公司。NIC 的業務為股票、債券、共同基金、交易所交易基金及顧問服務等經紀活動，以及年金與保險產品，主要服務於銀行的客戶。這些年金、共同基金及其他投資產品並未由 FDIC 或任何其他政府機構承保。這些產品並非存款，亦非銀行的義務或保證。直到 2018 年 2 月 16 日，證券經由 Invest Financial，一家註冊經紀商／經紀經紀人銷售。自 2018 年 2 月 16 日起，經紀商／經紀經紀人關係轉移至 LPL Financial LLC（"LPL"），這是因為 Invest 在 2017 年出售給 LPL。LPL 為一家註冊經紀商，並為 FINRA 和 SIPC 會員。NIC 在 2025 年及 2024 年為本公司產生的毛收入分別為 708,000 美元及 407,000 美元，已包含在其他收入中。
WCB Realty Corp.，一家賓夕法尼亞州公司，為銀行之完全擁有之不動產子公司，其主要資產為公司的行政辦公室，也包括銀行的總行辦公室。
WTRO Properties Inc.（"WTRO"），一家賓夕法尼亞州公司，為銀行之完全擁有之不動產子公司，設立目的是持有銀行已拍賣的不動產所有權。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日及 2024 年 12 月 31 日，WTRO 所持有已拍賣不動產的未償還金額分別為 0 美元及 0 美元。

paragraphs: 本項管理層討論與分析及相關財務資料係為協助瞭解與評估本公司及銀行於2025年12月31日及2024年12月31日之財務狀況與營運成果，以及2025年度及2024年度之財務狀況與營運成果。本節應與合併財務報表及相關附註一併閱讀。

2024年度，本公司之財務狀況與營運成果受到兩項交易之重大影響。2024年12月23日，本公司完成公開發行並出售1,150,000股普通股，每股價格為26.00美元，導致本公司取得淨資金約28百萬美元（"發行"）。發行後立即，本公司利用發行所得資金的一部分，重新配置本公司大部分可供出售債務證券投資組合。本公司進行重新配置交易之目標為提高投資組合之獲利性、改善流動性、強化資本結構並支持未來成長。請參閱下方"財務狀況－證券"部分以取得更多有關重新配置交易之資訊。
本公司合併財務報表之附註2列示用以發展與呈現財務報表之重大會計政策。本項討論與分析、重大會計政策及其他財務報表揭露資訊，識別並處理理解與評估本公司及其營運成果所必需之關鍵變數及其他質性與量化因素。
近期可能產生重大變動之重要估計數，與信用減損準備之確定及商譽減損之確定有關。請參閱"信用減損準備及非 Performing 資產"部分中關於信用減損準備計算之討論，位於"財務狀況"節中。

2011年取得North Penn時，本公司記錄商譽金額為9.7百萬美元，代表支付金額超過取得日所購機構淨資產公允價值之差額。2016年取得Delaware時，本公司記錄商譽金額為1.6百萬美元，代表支付金額超過取得日所購機構淨資產公允價值之差額。2020年7月取得UpState時，本公司記錄商譽金額為17.9百萬美元，代表支付金額超過取得日所購機構淨資產公允價值之差額。商譽每年進行測試，當商譽帳面價值超過其隱含公允價值時，即被視為減損。
